_readme: Machine-readable art tracker for GCD Tourney. Spec: art/SPEC.md (hi-res sprite spec v2, ADR 0007). Human view: art/TRACKER.md; review queue: art/REVIEW.md (keep all three in sync). Top-level version = manifest format (2 = spec v2 with per-asset version fields). The packer reads spec, animationDefaults, characters and vfx, plus the approvedVersion fields of vfx.effects, worldArt.* batches and sharedUi: world art ships approved items only (ADR 0012). status: todo | raw | packed | approved. version = latest candidate number NN of the asset (file suffix _vNN; 0 = nothing generated yet); approvedVersion = the NN the user approved (null until then). Versions are never reused; rejected candidates move to a _rejected/ folder. Strips: raw/<anim>_vNN.png (the packer uses the highest). References: candidates reference/<name>_vNN.png, the approved one is copied to file (the approved idle strip is also copied to reference/idle_approved.png). UI: candidates raw/ui_<name>_vNN.png, the approved one is copied to file. step = generation order (art/PIPELINE.md). ms = default per-frame durations written to anims.json. animationDefaults = copy-me block for a new character.

scaleManualQA.note: Low-confidence crouch probe. Compared native 48-color packed frame with approved title combat at one cell scale: hair/skull width, neck-to-belt volume, bent thighs/shins and sandals remain anatomically consistent; head reads 1.00 of idle after source-calibrated pose height 128. Deep crouch explains 128px occupied height; foot projection is smaller by about 15%, with 2px landmark uncertainty.

scaleExemptFrames.3: v09: the bowed dive head shows its crown, so the hair silhouette reads 1.14 while the face stays the idle's size; the user chose to ship v09 with this recorded exception (2026-10-11)

scaleManualQA.note: Low-confidence tumble probe (heads 0.79/0.83 of idle). Compared both native 48-colour cells with approved title combat/neutral and idle f0 at one scale (2x/3x/4x): skull, face, headband plate and collar match idle/combat; hair spikes are flatter in the backward fling (the probe's low reading); torso length, sleeves and leg chains match. Sandals: f1 1.00 of combat (linear, dark-area), f0 1.16/1.27 (f0's upper sandal is sole-on). No clipping (x10..183).

Low-confidence rotating probe (heads 1.07/1.07/1.11). Compared all three native 48-colour cells with approved title combat at one scale: tuck, inverted tuck and landing-ready poses keep combat's head, face, torso and limb chains; sandals 0.95-1.13 of combat per frame (one sole-on f0 sandal 1.28). All poses inside the cell.

Low-confidence lying probe (heads 1.00/0.92). User-preserved original down poses restyled. Compared both native 48-colour cells with approved title combat/neutral at one scale: head, torso and leg chains match; supine length 224 px vs 205 px standing neutral (extended leg, pointed foot); sandals 1.13-1.25 of combat (linear). Floor contact (f1 28% within 6px, worst fifth 7px above y240) is left to the coordinator's in-game grounding check.

Low-confidence kip-up probe. Compared all five native 48-color scratch atlas frames against approved title combat at one 256px cell scale: heads, neck-to-belt volume, long limbs and sandal size stay consistent through the lying, inverted, airborne and crouched phases. Measured source pose height 195 makes final stance 165px, equal to approved combat. Head estimates range 1.020-1.103 of provisional idle and feet 0.927-1.027; rotated/occluded poses have about 2px landmark uncertainty. This is anatomy scale only; down-to-getup motion continuity remains unapproved.

Low-confidence crouch/toe-rise probe. Compared both native 48-color atlas cells with approved title neutral and combat in one 256px cell scale: hair/skull width, compact face, neck-to-belt torso, limb lengths and sandal proportions remain consistent. Toe-rise frame is intentionally 221px high versus approved neutral 205px; crouch is 142px occupied, not resized to standing. Probe heads 1.059/1.026 and feet 0.861/0.981 of provisional idle; bent crouch and lifted heels make foot landmarks uncertain by about 2px. Anatomy scale only; final animation review pending.

decals._readme: Ground-damage decals (ADR 0024, art/decals/README.md). Names, cells, variants, groups, modes and color rules are the engine contract (DECAL_SPECS in tools/pack-decals.mjs; drift is warned). npm run sprites decals packs approved items (approvedVersion here or on worldArt.decal batches) into public/decals/atlas.json + the PNG pages of each page set (at most 4 per match); --candidates writes public/preview/decals/.
decals.candidates: art/decals/raw/<name>_vNN.png, or the parts <name>_vNN_A.png, _B.png, _C.png of one version
